MY HACKTOBERFEST

Your Hacktoberfest
codes and offers.

Tools to help you build with open-source and open-weight models throughout Hacktoberfest.

7 CODES
Free .tech Domain for 1 Year

Get a free .tech domain for your first year. Redeem your code at get.tech. One code per person. Codes expire December 30, 2026.

Challenge at your Hack Day: Best .Tech Domain Name

Get your code
$5 in Backboard credit

Sign up for Backboard, then enter your code on the Billing page. No credit card needed. Build with Backboard in any of the ongoing Hacktoberfest DEV Challenges to be eligible for weekly prizes. Works on new and existing accounts. One per person.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of Backboard

Get your code
Browserbase - 1 Month Free (Developer Plan)

One free month of Browserbase's Developer plan. Enter the code when you sign up. Card required to activate. The Free plan needs no code. One per person. Card required.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of Browserbase

Get your code
ElevenLabs - 1 Month Free

Integrate fully autonomous audio experiences into your Hacktoberfest projects with ElevenLabs and give your project a voice! Receive 1 month of the Creator tier free. No Credit Card Required. Codes do not stack, limited to one code per account.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of ElevenLabs

Get your code
$5 Paper Instruments Credit

$5 of Paper Instruments credit. Already have an account? Apply your code on the billing page. New to Paper Instruments? Sign up with your code to skip the waitlist and get $5. One code per account.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of Paper Instruments

Get your code
$50 in Render credit

Open the link to add the credit to your Render account. Deploy your project on Render in any of the ongoing Hacktoberfest DEV Challenges to be eligible for weekly prizes. One claim per person. Claim by November 15, 2026.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of Render

Get your code
$10 Credit for Tinker from Thinking Machines

$10 credit for Tinker from Thinking Machines. Utilize your promo code as part of your project in any of the ongoing Hacktoberfest DEV Challenges to be eligible for weekly prizes. Use Tinker to fine-tune a model for a specific task, and demonstrate a clear improvement in performance, latency or cost compared to a baseline. Each hacker may only receive 1 promo code for Tinker.

Challenge on DEV: Best Use of Tinker

Get your code
